text:
Hi Andrea — I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience building data and AI systems with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, and pandas.

One relevant project was a Contract clause search assistant for a legal client. I built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. It achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

For your eCommerce strategy role, I’d bring a strong analytical approach to funnel data, competitor analysis, and turning findings into actionable steps for the team. I’m comfortable working remotely and in CET-aligned collaboration.

What are the main data sources and dashboards you use today to evaluate brand growth and funnel performance?
